grammarOverview.title: Grammar Overview (Cumulative)
grammarOverview.summary: Gustavo is building the foundations he needs for school English and more confident speaking. The main goal is to turn familiar vocabulary into complete, accurate short sentences.
focusPoints: Past Simple affirmative: build short real-life sentences such as I went, I played and I bought.
Past Simple negative: use didn't + base verb, for example I didn't play.
Past Simple questions: use Did + subject + base verb, for example Did you travel?
Past of be: distinguish was and were in short personal sentences.
Complete-sentence building: move from isolated words to short, school-ready answers.
Numbers and pronunciation: continue discrimination practice such as fifteen vs fifty.

teacherFeedback.title: Current teacher feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Gustavo responds very well when English is connected to his real interests. He is willing to speak, repeat, try again and self-correct with support. His strongest current signal is participation and willingness to communicate.

teacherFeedback.title: Current growth priority
teacherFeedback.body: The next step is to build complete short answers and recycle a small number of high-value structures, especially I went, I played, I didn't..., Did you...?, was and were.
